# apple_bundle_id (Resource)

Registers a bundle ID (App ID) that identifies an app in the developer account. Import it by its App Store Connect ID or its bundle identifier.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_bundle_id" "app" {
  identifier = "com.example.app"
  name       = "Example App"
  platform   = "IOS"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identifier` (String) Bundle identifier, e.g. `com.example.app`, or a wildcard such as `com.example.*`. Changing it creates a new bundle ID.
- `name` (String) Name of the bundle ID in the developer account.
- `platform` (String) Platform: `IOS`, `MAC_OS`, `UNIVERSAL`. Changing it creates a new resource.

### Optional

- `seed_id` (String) App ID prefix. Defaults to the team ID. Changing it creates a new bundle ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the bundle ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_bundle_id.app
  identity = {
    id = "F7F5U6U6H8"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the bundle ID.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By App Store Connect ID or by bundle identifier.
terraform import apple_bundle_id.app F7F5U6U6H8
terraform import apple_bundle_id.app com.example.app
```
